summary: I changed one file, `solution/core.py`, and the visible suite now passes (2 passed). The bug was in the merge step of `merge`. When an interval overlapped the previous merged one, the code set the end to the new interval's end (`out[-1] = (pa, b)`) instead of the larger of the two ends (`max(pb, b)`). Because the intervals are sorted by start, a later interval can still end earlier when it sits fully inside the previous one, like `(2, 3)` inside `(1, 4)` or the single point `(2, 2)` inside `(1, 3)`. In those cases the merged interval got cut short. The same mistake affected every merge path, including overlaps, duplicates and touching intervals, so a one-line change to keep the maximum end fixes it everywhere without special-casing the tests.
